info.title: SYNTHORA emerging_protocols
info.description: Unlock real-time M2M payments with x402 API—streaming protocol data, auto-settled per call. Signed x402 call. 0.03 USDC on Base.
info.x-guidance: Paid x402 endpoint: POST without a payment header returns HTTP 402 with a payment-required challenge (scheme exact, USDC on Base, network eip155:8453, payTo 0xEf879BFD6C4AccB8F795136de90246e1EC245e06). Settle through the facilitator and retry with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header (x402 v2) or X-PAYMENT (v1). Machine-readable payment terms: /.well-known/x402.json. Results are deterministic and Ed25519-signed.
